using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Http;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Http.Modeling;
using Volo.Abp.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.Tests.CSharp;

public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<CliHttpClientFactory> _cliHttpClientFactoryMock;
    private readonly Mock<IJsonSerializer> _jsonSerializerMock;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly CSharpServiceProxyGenerator _generator;

    public CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests()
    {
        _cliHttpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>();
        _jsonSerializerMock = new Mock<IJsonSerializer>();
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>();

        _generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(
            _cliHttpClientFactoryMock.Object,
            _jsonSerializerMock.Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _loggerMock.Object
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_Should_LogInformation_When_Creating_Interface_File()
    {
        // Arrange
        var args = new GenerateProxyArgs
        {
            Url = "https://test.com",
            WorkDirectory = "/test/workdir",
            Module = "default",
            WithoutContracts = false,
            CommandName = "generate-proxy"
        };

        // Mock the API model to have at least one controller with interface
        var apiModel = CreateMinimalApiModel();
        _jsonSerializerMock
            .Setup(x => x.Deserialize<ApplicationApiDescriptionModel>(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .Returns(apiModel);

        // Act
        await _generator.GenerateProxyAsync(args);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Create") && v.ToString().Contains(".cs")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()
            ),
            Times.AtLeastOnce
        );
    }

    private ApplicationApiDescriptionModel CreateMinimalApiModel()
    {
        var model = ApplicationApiDescriptionModel.Create();
        var module = new ModuleApiDescriptionModel("default");
        
        var controller = new ControllerApiDescriptionModel("TestController");
        var @interface = new InterfaceApiDescriptionModel("ITestAppService");
        controller.Interfaces.Add(@interface);
        
        module.Controllers.Add("TestController", controller);
        model.AddModule(module);
        
        return model;
    }
}

using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying;
using Volo.Abp.Http.Modeling;
using Volo.Abp.Json;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Http;
using Xunit;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.Tests.CSharp;

public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<CliHttpClientFactory> _cliHttpClientFactoryMock;
    private readonly Mock<IJsonSerializer> _jsonSerializerMock;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly CSharpServiceProxyGenerator _generator;

    public CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests()
    {
        _cliHttpClientFactoryMock = new();
        _jsonSerializerMock = new();
        _loggerMock = new();

        _generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(
            _cliHttpClientFactoryMock.Object,
            _jsonSerializerMock.Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _loggerMock.Object
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_Should_LogInformation_When_Creating_Interface_File()
    {
        // Arrange
        var args = new GenerateProxyArgs(
            url: "https://test.com",
            workDirectory: "/test/workdir",
            module: "default",
            commandName: "generate-proxy",
            folder: null,
            serviceType: null,
            withoutContracts: false,
            additionalProperties: null
        );

        // Mock minimal API response that will trigger interface generation
        var apiJson = @"{
            ""modules"": {
                ""default"": {
                    ""controllers"": {
                        ""Test"": {
                            ""interfaces"": [{
                                ""type"": ""ITestAppService"",
                                ""methods"": []
                            }]
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }";

        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
        mockHttpClient.Setup(x => x.GetStringAsync(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(apiJson);

        _cliHttpClientFactoryMock.Setup(x => x.CreateClient(false))
            .Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

        _jsonSerializerMock.Setup(x => x.Deserialize<ApplicationApiDescriptionModel>(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .Returns(() => ApplicationApiDescriptionModel.Create());

        // Act
        await _generator.GenerateProxyAsync(args);

        // Assert - verify LogInformation was called for file creation
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                    v.ToString().Contains("Create ") && 
                    v.ToString().EndsWith(".cs")
                ),
                null!,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ),
            Times.AtLeastOnce
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LoggerProperty_Should_Be_Usable_For_LogInformation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>().Object;
        _generator.Logger = logger;

        // Act
        _generator.Logger.LogInformation("Test log message");

        // Assert - compilation verifies the extension method works
        Assert.True(true);
    }
}
